Origin and meaning

Eleanor is a French name meaning “bright, shining one”.

About the name Eleanor

Eleanor Roosevelt, the influential US first lady and diplomat, bore this name.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Eleanor as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “bright, shining one”, is part of the appeal.
